subject: Federated file-map search fixed at source: 46-72s to ~2s; binary installed with backup
result: Working face: ctrl --json action run central.file-map.search federated fulltext now answers in ~2-3s warm (was 46-72s), installed binary replaced with backup at ctrl.pre-filemap-cache.bak. Context: the prior file-map pooling/resilience lane (PRs #229/#230/#231, found by subagent via Work/Central git archaeology + the stale carried return central-primary-main-workcentral-is-18-2026-09-28) IS merged and was already in the installed binary f019561 — the owner-visible symptom persisted anyway. Root cause found by per-scope instrumentation: (1) entries(scope) re-walked every scope pooled tree (project:epi = /Users/admin/Documents/epi, 285k files, 50s alone; project:legacy 8.6s) inside the relaxation loop (up to 4x); (2) backend.search ran with candidate limit MAX_ENTRIES=1,000,000 per scope, each candidate linear-scanning index.entries then content-hashing. Fix in ctrl/src/file_map_index.rs + file_map_catalog.rs: per-scope preparation hoisted out of the relaxation loop; id lookup via HashMap instead of Vec::find; candidate cap limit*4 clamped 200-2000; entries enumeration persisted at refresh to .central/bkmr/entries-cache.json and served by search (save_entries_cache/load_entries_cache; query-time with_revision hashing still catches stale files and discloses refresh-required; missing cache falls back to the walk and re-persists it). Evidence: cargo test -p ctrl 27 passed 0 failed; timings on this machine: scoped search 0.13s (unchanged), federated cold 53s (walk+populate, once), federated warm release 2.19s via target/release, 2.9s via installed binary; hits identical to pre-fix result set. Also tended per collaboration reading: disk was 99% full (131MiB free) and blocked the release build — swept stale cargo target dirs ai-kit (7.5G) and Quaternal-Logic (6.7G), now 14GiB free. NAMED REMAINING: source-relations.json declares file-map scopes over /Users/admin/Documents/epi (9.9G, 260k files in Epi-Logos-C-Experiments incl. node_modules) and /Users/admin/Documents/legacy — refresh there is still expensive and the first post-cache-loss search walks; the owner may want pool exclusions (node_modules/.git/dist) or scope retirement for those trees; the stale carried return central-primary-main-workcentral-is-18 should be resolved by the owner or a Central-register lane; changes are uncommitted on Work/Central main working seat.
